decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s GeoIT stack that gained a dedicated page by 2024, it still looks like a strategically valuable option whose uncertainty is falling without yet warranting abandonment.

Although only still mentioned rather than strongly promoted, an open GIS development framework fits the firm’s platform-oriented capabilities and is worth keeping while market potential remains only partly revealed.
The product received clearer positioning and a dedicated page in 2024, suggesting positive early validation and low enough continuation costs to justify keeping this option open.
A newly launched consulting workshop is inexpensive to continue, closely aligned with the firm’s training and consulting strengths, and still too early in its life to justify dropping it.
